verdict.rationale: Sticky proxy IPs are a fair question for a headless-browser platform that markets anti-bot and login handling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions proxies, IP persistence, or routing requests through the same IP via a session identifier. Browser sessions and CAPTCHA handling are adjacent features and do not show a sticky proxy IP capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity
